🎬 American Sports Story: Aaron Hernandez (2024)

American Sports Story: Aaron Hernandez follows the dramatic rise and tragic downfall of Aaron Hernandez, a talented football player whose promising NFL career became overshadowed by criminal investigations, violence, and personal struggles. Growing up in Bristol, Connecticut, Hernandez demonstrates exceptional athletic ability, eventually earning a place at the University of Florida before joining the New England Patriots as a professional tight end. As his football career reaches extraordinary heights, he gains fame, financial success, and recognition as one of the league’s promising young stars. However, behind his achievements lies a complicated personal life shaped by family tensions, emotional struggles, difficult relationships, and increasingly dangerous decisions. As Hernandez becomes involved with people and situations that threaten his future, his actions begin attracting the attention of law enforcement. His arrest and subsequent murder conviction shock the sports world, transforming his story from one of athletic success into a deeply troubling criminal case. Throughout the series, the narrative examines the pressures of professional sports, the influence of personal trauma, and the warning signs surrounding Hernandez’s behavior. It also explores the devastating consequences of his choices for victims, families, teammates, and everyone connected to the case. Combining intense drama, psychological storytelling, and real-life events, the series explores fame, ambition, identity, violence, accountability, and the tragic consequences of a promising life unraveling.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Crime • Drama • Sports

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 45–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Stu Zicherman

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu and Disney+ for current streaming availability. Availability varies by region.
